ranking.name: Planet Gap
ranking.rationale: Raw weighted score 66.5, no adjustment. The research found no exact game, app or trademark on Google Play, the App Store, Steam or the web. The nearest is 'Space Gap', a different game. It has the best concept fit of all candidates (85): the player flies through gaps in towers of planets, which is what the name says. The weaknesses are moderate: the GAP clothing brand adds noise to social search and is a famous mark outside classes 9/41, and the trademark databases were not checked directly.

ranking.chosenRationale:
How the scores were worked out: each total uses the given weights (originality 15%, memorability 15%, pronunciation 10%, conceptFit 15%, marketing 15%, searchVisibility 10%, lowConflictRisk 20%). Totals were then lowered by 8 to 20 points where a game with the same or nearly the same name already exists. A name used by a published game was not allowed into the top 5, which removed Planet Dash (Chrome Web Store game), Planet Rift (Sandbox MMORPG), Nova Dash, Rocket Rift, Planet Escape, Orbit Escape and others. Names with incomplete research lost 1 to 4 points for that uncertainty. 'Slip' names lost 6 points because 'slip' means underwear in TR, DE, FR, IT and ES.

Why Planet Gap: it has the highest adjusted total (66.5) and the research found no exact game, app or trademark on Google Play, the App Store, Steam or the web, so its conflict risk is low. It also fits the game best (85). The game is about flying through the gaps in towers of planets, so the name says what you do on the first screenshot. 'Planet' is understood in every target language and also renders the 'Gezegen' half of the Turkish title, so the two names belong together. It is two short, easy words that a 10+ player in any of the target markets can say and remember.

Why not the others in the top 5:
- Planetgate (63.6) has a scandal sound ('-gate') and echoes MGM's STARGATE.
- Astro Gap (63.75) competes with crowded ASTRO marks (Astro Bot, ASTRO GAMING) and loses the planet link.
- Starlane Escape (61.9) is long, easy to mispronounce and 'Escape' is generic.
- Planet Weave (59.5) has not been researched at all.

Store title: 'Planet Gap – Gezegen Kaçışı' is 27 characters, within Google Play's 30. An English listing could use 'Planet Gap: Tap & Fly' (21) or 'Planet Gap: Space Flyer' (23). Using 'PlanetGap' as one word for the package name, domain and social handles would help it be found despite the GAP clothing brand.

What still needs checking: no candidate's trademark databases could actually be queried. Before launch, search TURKPATENT, EUIPO, USPTO and WIPO for 'PLANET GAP' in classes 9 and 41. Also confirm that GAP Inc.'s famous-mark rights do not reach games. If that check turns something up, Astro Gap is the next safest choice.
